Ever wondered how computers sort data? 🤔 Today, we're diving into the charmingly simple, yet surprisingly effective, Gnome Sort! 🍄 Watch as our little gnome sorts an array with just a few basic moves. It's like a tiny digital gardener taming your unsorted lists! 🌳

In this video, you'll discover:
✅ The core logic behind Gnome Sort
✅ A clear, visual step-by-step walkthrough
✅ When this quirky algorithm shines (and when it doesn't!)
✅ How it compares to other sorting methods

Perfect for beginners and algorithm enthusiasts alike! ✨
